name: SENTINEL
base_investment_score_source: max(ODIN v14, Gungnir v46) per catalyst type

size_tilt.nano_micro_alpha: LOTTERY_OK — up to 2% equity, OTM options permitted

known_limitations: C1 validated forward-only (LunarCrush free tier has no historical snapshots)
C5 uses filing counts as proxy; dollar magnitude & insider-role not yet parsed
C6 overextension modifier applied (-3 if r30>50% AND vol_spike>2x)
C7 parses sentiment label + keyword hits; no full-LLM classifier yet
Applied only to top 40 C2+C3+C4 finalists (budget-conscious)

backtest_2025_holdout.method: Stratified random sample, n=80 (40 APPROVAL, 40 CRL) drawn from 345 2025 PDUFA events

excluded.C1_social: no historical snapshots on free LunarCrush tier
excluded.C7_news: news queries cannot be reliably date-filtered

honest_interpretation: AUC ≈ 0.50 across individual and summed components on 2025 PDUFA holdout.
SENTINEL components as currently designed carry NO meaningful signal for APPROVAL vs CRL on 2025 survivor-biased cohort.
The 2025 cohort is selected (made it to PDUFA); most residual signal is already captured by ODIN v14 (HO AUC 0.8995 honest).
SENTINEL should be treated as a RANKING CO-SORTER within ODIN tiers, NOT a probability modifier.
The KILL switch (raw<15) triggered on ZERO events in this cohort — minimum observed raw was 14.
C6 (price momentum) was the only component trending positive (AUC 0.523) — consistent with market sniffing out approvals.
Do NOT blindly apply the ±25% boost to probabilities — use it only to re-rank within tier, not to alter model-calibrated probabilities.
backtest_2025_holdout.actionable_rule: Use SENTINEL for ranking WITHIN ODIN/Gungnir tiers only. Do not update probability scores directly.
known_blind_spots: C3 set to constant 10 in backtest (OT API was slow) — forward validation needed
n=80 sample, SE on AUC ±0.06 — signal <0.06 above/below 0.5 is within noise
2025 cohort heavily approval-skewed (71.3%) — under-represents CRL base rates of ODIN training
